primary_scoring.reason: ITTE v1.2 is an image-only evaluation. Theme descriptions are explanatory metadata and must not influence the primary score.

anti_leakage_rules: When generating or evaluating one pair, exclude that app's real themed counterpart from the reference bank.
Split by canonical_app_id, never by individual image.
Do not expose the gold themed image, its crop record, or a per-image description to the generator.
Report each theme separately and report macro average because theme sizes are imbalanced.
Keep image-only and text-assisted results in separate tables.

calibratable_from_current_data: style component weights for correct-theme ranking
identity component weights for correct-App retrieval
package component parameters for coherent-versus-mixed real-theme discrimination
not_identifiable_from_current_data: unique trade-off among style, identity, package and quality
weight_calibration.rule: Tune only dimension-internal weights against objective labels, using grouped cross-validation and per-theme macro metrics. Keep top-level weights explicitly provisional.

recommended_uses.style: Rank the query or generated icon against four balanced theme reference banks; report per-theme Top-1, MRR and margin.
recommended_uses.identity: Retrieve the correct target from the fixed 91-original gallery; report Top-1, Top-5, MRR and margin.
recommended_uses.paired_generation: For each pair_manifest row, generate from the original and compare against the held-out real themed counterpart.
recommended_uses.package: Use package_pair_manifest for same-app cross-theme replacements and controlled mixture tests.
recommended_uses.quality: With clean positive images only, report clean-set false-alarm rate and score distribution. Do not tune the quality weight from this dataset.
